question: Which products cost more than 100 euros?
gold_sql: SELECT id, name, category, price, stock FROM products WHERE price > 100 ORDER BY id
notes: Filtered SELECT — agent should return all product columns

question: What are the total sales per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name
notes: Aggregate via order_items — more accurate than orders.total

question: List all completed orders sorted by date descending.
gold_sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, status, total FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' ORDER BY order_date DESC
notes: Filter + sort — agent should return all order columns

question: Which customer placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC LIMIT 1
notes: The answer is the customer name — count column is not required

question: What is the average order total?
Show me all products in the Electronics category.
gold_sql: SELECT id, name, category, price, stock FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY id
notes: Simple filter — agent should return all product columns

question: How many items were sold per product?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name

question: What is the total revenue from completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: Which countries do our customers come from?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers ORDER BY country
